title: Capstone: Design a Schema
summary: Design a database for a real app (blog, store, booking): list entities, define columns/types/constraints, sketch relationships, then write C
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Design a database for a real app (blog, store, booking): list entities, define columns/types/constraints, sketch relationships, then write CREATE TABLE statements and sample queries.
Checklist: every table has a PK, FKs enforce relationships, junction tables for many-to-many, indexes on lookup columns, and seed data to test queries.
Key points: sketch on paper first, normalize reasonably (not perfectly), and validate with real queries — a schema you cannot query is not done.

sections.codeExample:
-- blog schema sketch
users(id, name, email)
posts(id, user_id FK, title, body, created_at)
comments(id, post_id FK, user_id FK, text)

sections.content: Summary: Capstone: Design a Schema — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
